sloka: तत् स्वभावो मम अपि एष यद् अगाधो अहम् अप्लवः ।विकारस् तु भवेद् राध एतत् ते प्रवदामि अहम् ॥६-२२-२६॥।।
transliteration: tat svabhāvo mama api eṣa yad agādho aham aplavaḥ ।vikāras tu bhaved rādha etat te pravadāmi aham ॥6-22-26॥।।

translations.english: "I am fathomless and as such not capable of being swum across as it is my nature too. My fording will be a deviation. I proclaim to you (how you can cross)."
